test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All milk are white.

Some white are red.

Conclusions:

I. All red are milk.

II. No red is a milk.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
From above statement,

All milk**(M)** are white**(W)**.

Some white are red**(R)**.

The venn diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc998ee203d04aaa2c6c9b415363eebba3419e6271c552da57b26c6ac63b8bee.png] 

Conclusions venn diagram is,

I. All red are milk.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/685f66ab6d486e54787fc9f204cfde0752225d6110675f9054d8d276405c1374.png] 

II. No red is a milk. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77c7969c1c23a032299f5dd373ad1907b60023fd877272078da31c5402fa49cb.png] 

From venn diagram, we conclude that the Neither conclusion I nor II follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3"**
